description: UI layer for Cumulative Recall, built on FEAT-001's data layer: the recall island (card driver + untimed cross-note session modal), the index.astro markup (quiz-banks JSON blob, recall card, recall dialog shell, island import), and the CSS (recall card normal + lagging states, dialog shell copied global, .recall-source label, per-topic breakdown). Depends on FEAT-001 (recall.ts, recall-sample.ts, store v4).
steps: src/pages/index.astro — In the frontmatter build recallBanks: Record<string, Quiz> from site.quizzes via Object.fromEntries([...site.quizzes]). After the existing <script type='application/json' data-rm-review-labels ...> emit <script type='application/json' data-recall-banks set:html={JSON.stringify(recallBanks)} />.

src/pages/index.astro — Add recall card markup immediately after the [data-rm-review] card block. A root element data-recall-card hidden, rounded-xl bordered card using the accent treatment (mirror the review card's classes). Inside: a weekly section [data-recall-weekly] with [data-recall-weekly-topics], [data-recall-weekly-est], and a [data-recall-weekly-start] button; a monthly section [data-recall-monthly] with [data-recall-monthly-topics]/[data-recall-monthly-est]/[data-recall-monthly-start]; a [data-recall-lagging-msg] element for the 'Priority: you're N weeks behind' text. The island toggles a lagging class / data-recall-lagging attribute for the amber state. Keep markup accessible (buttons are real <button>/<a>, aria where review card uses it, visible focus).

src/pages/index.astro — Add the recall dialog shell near [data-rm-dialog]:
. In the bottom

src/components/recall.ts — NEW island. SSR-guard (if typeof document !== 'undefined'). Bind a delegated click listener once on document; re-init on astro:page-load; re-sync via onRecallChange from @/lib/recall. Read data-recall-banks into a Map<route, Quiz> and reuse the data-rm-review-labels map plus a labelFor() fallback (copy review-due.ts's approach). sync(): call pendingWeeklies(), isLagging(), pendingMonthly(); hide [data-recall-card] when all empty; else fill the weekly section (topic count = oldest pending cycle's routes.length; estimate via sampleRecall dry run topicCount/length or min(max, topics*perTopic)); when isLagging() add the lagging class/attribute and set [data-recall-lagging-msg] to 'Priority: you're N weeks behind' with N = pendingWeeklies().length; fill the monthly section when pendingMonthly() is non-null.

src/components/recall.ts — Session modal: on [data-recall-weekly-start]/[data-recall-monthly-start], build the sample via sampleRecall over the pending cycle's routes (weekly, WEEKLY_SAMPLE) or monthly routes (MONTHLY_SAMPLE), filtered to routes present in the banks Map, with labelFor; store the active session in a module variable { kind, cycleEnd?, questions, index, outcomes }; showModal() on [data-recall-dialog]. Render into [data-recall-modal] reusing the GLOBAL quiz stepper classes (.quiz-head/.quiz-prog/.quiz-pills/.quiz-body/.quiz-opts/.quiz-foot/.quiz-btn*) and the exact one-question-at-a-time pick-one-advance UX from quiz.ts, but UNTIMED (no timer element, no deadline, no attempt persistence). Render a .recall-source 'From: {sourceLabel}' label above each stem. Support mcq/scenario (auto-grade against answer) and card (flip + self-grade) as quiz.ts does.

src/components/recall.ts — End-of-session score card using .quiz-score/.quiz-ring/.quiz-score-pct/.quiz-score-msg PLUS a .recall-breakdown per-topic list (correct/total grouped by sourceLabel) and a Done button. On completion mark the cycle done via a store update() (import update from @/lib/store): weekly appends cycleEnd to recallWeeklyDone (dedupe), monthly sets recallMonthlyDone = Date.now(). These are the ONLY store writes — do NOT touch progress, review, or attempts. Native <dialog> handles Esc/backdrop close; the close handler resets session state. Detailed header comment matching the quiz.ts/review-due.ts style.

src/styles/global.css — Add near the .rm-review-chip / quiz blocks: (a) recall card classes — normal accent state (baseline from the review card) and a lagging/priority warning variant via amber color-mix keyed off [data-recall-lagging] or a .recall-lagging class; (b) the recall dialog SHELL .recall-dialog/.recall-shell/.recall-modal copied from NoteContent.astro's scoped .quiz-dialog/.quiz-shell/.quiz-modal (including ::backdrop and dark-theme overrides) but GLOBAL here; (c) .recall-source — the small muted 'From: Topic' label (tone like .quiz-scenario); (d) .recall-breakdown list style. All colours via palette tokens (--accent-*/--gray-*/--success-*/--error-*); cover light and dark ([data-theme='dark']); respect existing reduced-motion rules.
acceptance_criteria: index.astro emits a data-recall-banks JSON blob containing all notes' quizzes keyed by route, has the hidden recall card markup and the data-recall-dialog shell, and imports @/components/recall.

The recall island hides the card when nothing is pending, shows weekly/monthly sections with topic counts and estimates when pending, and shows the amber lagging state with an N-weeks-behind message when >=2 weeklies are pending.
Starting a recall opens an UNTIMED cross-note stepper reusing the global .quiz-* classes, shows a 'From: Topic' label per question, and ends with a score card plus per-topic breakdown.
Completing a weekly appends its cycleEnd to recallWeeklyDone and completing a monthly sets recallMonthlyDone; no writes occur to progress, review, or attempts.
The recall dialog shell and card CSS exist globally and theme correctly in light and dark.
A visitor with no completions sees no new card and the existing review card/meter/roadmap still render.
Running `npm run typecheck` produces 0 new errors in src/ and `npm run build` exits 0 with 38 pages built and 30 indexed.
verification: npm run typecheck  — confirm 0 NEW errors in src/
npm run build  — confirm exit 0, '38 page(s) built', pagefind 'Indexed 30 pages'
Inspect dist/index.html — confirm the data-recall-banks JSON blob, the recall card and dialog markup, and a recall.*.js island reference are present
findings:
DONE. Implemented all seven steps.

FILES:
- src/pages/index.astro: imported `type { Quiz }` from @/lib/quiz; built `recallBanks: Record<string, Quiz> = Object.fromEntries([...site.quizzes])` in the frontmatter; emitted `<script type='application/json' data-recall-banks ...>` right after the data-rm-review-labels blob; added the hidden `[data-recall-card]` markup immediately after the `[data-rm-review]` card (header + lagging-msg + weekly section with topics/est/start + monthly section); added the `<dialog data-recall-dialog class='recall-dialog'>` shell (recall-shell > recall-modal) just before the data-rm-data script; added `import '@/components/recall';` to the bottom <script> block.
- src/components/recall.ts: NEW island. SSR-guarded. Delegated click on document bound once, re-init on astro:page-load (re-binds the dialog's click/close listeners each init since a View Transition can swap the node), onRecallChange(sync). Reads data-recall-banks into Map<route,Quiz> and the data-rm-review-labels map with a labelFor() fallback copied from review-due.ts. sync() hides the card when no weekly/monthly pending; fills weekly from the OLDEST pending cycle that has quizzed topics; estimate = min(opts.max, sum of min(perTopic, quiz.length)); toggles .recall-lagging + data-recall-lagging and fills the N-weeks-behind message when isLagging(); fills monthly from pendingMonthly() filtered to banked routes. Session modal reuses the GLOBAL .quiz-* stepper classes, UNTIMED (no timer/deadline/attempt), one-question pick-and-advance for mcq/scenario and flip+self-grade for card, with a `.recall-source` 'From: {label}' line above each stem. Score card uses .quiz-score/.quiz-ring/.quiz-score-pct/.quiz-score-msg plus a `.recall-breakdown` per-topic correct/total list grouped by sourceLabel in first-seen order. Completion calls update() ONCE: weekly appends cycleEnd to recallWeeklyDone (store dedupes on save), monthly sets recallMonthlyDone = Date.now(). NO writes to progress/review/attempts. Native <dialog> handles Esc/backdrop; close handler drops session + re-syncs.
- src/styles/global.css: added, after the quiz reduced-motion block, the .recall-lagging card variant (amber via --warning-* color-mix, light+dark), the GLOBAL dialog shell .recall-dialog/.recall-shell/.recall-modal copied from NoteContent.astro's scoped quiz shell (incl ::backdrop + dark overrides), .recall-source (accent, uppercase micro-label), and the .recall-breakdown list (rows with topic + score, .is-ok -> success colour). All palette tokens; light + dark covered.

VERIFICATION: `npm run typecheck` -> 44 errors / 0 in any NEW or edited src/ file I own (all 44 are the documented pre-existing baseline: scripts/*.ts, *.test.ts, tests/*.ts, src/content.config.ts, remark/*, several component islands, and the index.astro SVG `//` inline-comment false-positives in the pre-existing roadmap graph at lines ~988-1039 and ~1265 script-is:inline warnings — none in the recall card/dialog markup I added). `npm run build` exits 0: '38 page(s) built', pagefind 'Indexed 30 pages'. dist/index.html contains the data-recall-banks blob, the data-recall-card markup, and the data-recall-dialog shell; the recall island is bundled into the index.astro module chunk index.html loads (confirmed the `recallWeeklyDone` store-writer string present in /_astro/index.astro_astro_type_script_index_0_lang.*.js). A visitor with no completions keeps the card hidden (island reveals it only when a cycle is pending), so the existing review card/meter/roadmap render unchanged.

INTEGRATION NOTES for later features: the recall card markup data-hooks are [data-recall-card] (root; gets .recall-lagging + data-recall-lagging), [data-recall-lagging-msg], [data-recall-weekly] (section) with [data-recall-weekly-topics]/[data-recall-weekly-est]/[data-recall-weekly-start] (start button carries data-cycleEnd), and the monthly mirror [data-recall-monthly]/-topics/-est/-start. The dialog is [data-recall-dialog] > [data-recall-modal]. The island is the ONLY recall-done writer: weekly -> recallWeeklyDone.push(cycleEnd); monthly -> recallMonthlyDone = Date.now(). No markWeeklyDone/markMonthlyDone facade was added (the writes are inline in recall.ts markCycleDone); if a future feature needs them from elsewhere, promote those two update() calls into recall.ts exports. DEVIATIONS: none from the FEAT-002 spec.
